prompts:
Create Satanael draft V3 by changing the POSE of reference1. Retain reference1's exact character armor/horn/revolver/wing designs, dark matte antique bronze-gray and black palette, subdued burgundy lining, red eyes, bold black ink outlines and clean two-plane P5 cel shading. References2 and3 are original-game action atmosphere/posture references. Do not copy the lighting or screenshot backgrounds. Single transparent game sprite, waist-to-horn tips, 2:3 TALL PORTRAIT, highest native detail available, requested2400x3600. Keep entire revolver and muzzle visible as the user explicitly requested.

V3 gesture must be dramatically different from reference1. A POWERFUL FORWARD PRESS, as if a colossal demon is thrusting the weapon down toward a distant enemy. Rotate ribcage and waist further to SCREEN RIGHT, approximately two-thirds SIDE VIEW instead of frontal chest. Lean the torso 15 degrees TOWARD SCREEN RIGHT, waist trailing behind. The shoulder on the GUN SIDE juts aggressively FORWARD and UP, rolling the chest forward. Clear diagonal action line, NOT vertical upright stance.

Preserve ANATOMICAL LEFT HAND as the single firing hand. Far LEFT shoulder is on IMAGE RIGHT, opposite the prominent near RIGHT shoulder on image left. The anatomical RIGHT arm, coming from the near image-left shoulder, sweeps BACK AND OUT to SCREEN LEFT, elbow slightly bent, open spread clawed right hand balancing recoil. It never hangs vertically and never touches the gun. Clearly show TWO arms with separate readable shoulder-to-hand paths.
The LEFT upper arm, forearm and gun jab forcefully forward from the protracted far shoulder toward SCREEN RIGHT AND SLIGHTLY DOWN. Powerful reaching extension with slight natural elbow flex, NOT a rigid sideways horizontal T-pose. Bring arm and revolver slightly toward CAMERA for foreshortening, muzzle nearest and noticeably largest. One left hand grips enormous long-barreled ornate revolver, barrel longer than full visible shoulder-to-wrist arm, complete cylinder/frame/barrel/muzzle in frame with clear air at right. Muzzle aimed at far-ground enemy screen-right/down.

HEAD CUES ESSENTIAL: stretch neck forward and LOWER helmet, tuck chin close toward raised left shooting shoulder. Head follows the arm's DOWNWARD aiming line, narrow red eyes looking right/down along barrel. The horned helmet is in pronounced right-facing profile with one eye dominant. Do NOT keep head upright or gaze toward camera. Horn silhouette intact, at least60px clear of top/sides on final canvas.

BOTH MASSIVE BAT WINGS FLARE wide UP AND BACK, rigid membrane taut as if pushed backward by frontal wind; long wing tips rake toward screen LEFT/back. Wings frame the forward-leaning torso asymmetrically and may extend off sides. Cape and lower burgundy lining sweep BACK toward image left. More extreme LOW-ANGLE camera from far below: enlarged armored chest and nearby gun, smaller distant head/horns towering overhead. Strong ominous forward momentum from the shoulders, not a soldier posing at attention. Figure and weapon occupy the canvas, avoid excessive empty upper half.

Keep exact subdued charcoal BLACK armor, quiet desaturated aged bronze-gray trim, no gold shine. Bold outlines, flat two-tone hard cel shadows. NO background, sky, fog, aura, halo, baked light, smoke, flashes, particles, ground, cast shadow, text, labels, panels, extra arms or other characters. True alpha zero outside the character. One intact draft only.

Edit this dynamic Satanael V3 sprite. Keep the new leaning action, lowered helmet along the aiming line, low camera, exact subdued black/bronze armor design, huge wings flaring up/back, dark red fabric sweeping left, complete huge revolver and oversized nearest muzzle. Only fix WHICH ARM holds the gun. True transparent RGBA portrait 2:3, highest detail available, final intended2400x3600.

The current image is wrong-handed. The arm from the HUGE NEAR PAULDRON ON THE IMAGE LEFT (with round emblem) is his anatomical RIGHT arm and currently fires the gun. That SAME NEAR RIGHT arm MUST NOW SWEEP BACK TOWARD IMAGE LEFT with OPEN CLAWED HAND, balancing recoil. Draw a continuous readable path from that huge image-left shoulder down-left/back to the open claw. It must NEVER connect to the firearm. The open claw now farther left must be connected to the near right pauldron, rather than sprouting from behind it as an extra limb.

The gun is held ONLY by his anatomical LEFT HAND. The left arm is the FAR arm, beginning at the SMALLER FAR SHOULDER on IMAGE RIGHT just below/right of his lowered helmet. From that far right-side shoulder, draw the left upper arm and forearm thrusting down-right toward the camera and enemy, ending in the left hand gripping the existing massive revolver. Give the far shooting shoulder a raised forward-protracted silhouette. Two arms total, one from each shoulder. Near image-left shoulder=right arm back/open claw. Far image-right shoulder=left arm firing. Do not mirror whole image, do not change the direction of aim. Remove the previous gun arm crossing from the near left pauldron in front of the chest; replace it with the far left firing arm.

Keep the torso rotated strongly toward SCREEN RIGHT and leaning15degrees forward, head tucked toward raised far firing shoulder, red eye tracking barrel down/right. Keep full gun and muzzle inside canvas with transparent air after muzzle. Preserve waist-to-horn framing and huge flared wings allowed to clip edges. No background, atmosphere, glow, halo, smoke, muzzleflash, extra fingers, extra limbs or text. Two hard-edged cel shade planes, clean bold black outlines.
